NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 5 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 11 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 10, 9:50 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 5 DraftKings main slate at 27.3 DraftKings points for $9,800, at Arizona. Chase Brown (19.2, $6,900) and D'Andre Swift (19.2, $6,200) are next.

D'Andre Swift returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.10 projected points per $1,000 at $6,200.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 10, 9:50 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 5

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET at ARI ($9,800)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 27.3 DraftKings points at $9,800, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 8.1 points clear of Chase Brown. The model gives him 23.5 carries and 5.5 targets. The salary works out to 2.79 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 26 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 27.4 points with a simulated floor of 15.5 and a ceiling of 43.0, and he holds 41% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 5.5-point favorite on the road against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Chase Brown, CIN at MIA ($6,900)

Chase Brown projects 2nd at the position with 19.2 DraftKings points at $6,900. The model gives him 18.2 carries and 4.8 targets. The salary works out to 2.79 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 26 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 19.2 points with a simulated floor of 9.1 and a ceiling of 32.8, and he holds 14% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 7-point favorite on the road against Miami, with an implied team total of 25.25 in a game totaled at 43.5.

D'Andre Swift, CHI at GB ($6,200)

D'Andre Swift projects 3rd at the position with 19.2 DraftKings points at $6,200. The model gives him 20.7 carries and 2.7 targets. The salary works out to 3.10 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 26 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Swift averaged 19.4 points with a simulated floor of 9.3 and a ceiling of 33.4, and he holds 39% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Chicago is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Braelon Allen, NYJ vs CLE ($5,400)

Braelon Allen projects for 16.2 DraftKings points at $5,400, which works out to 2.99 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 26 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 17.7 carries and 2.4 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 16.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.7 and a ceiling of 30.8, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Jets are a 2.5-point favorite at home against Cleveland, with an implied team total of 21 in a game totaled at 39.5.
